title: papaver nudicaule subsp. corydalifolium
intro: Papaver nudicaule subsp. corydalifolium, commonly known as Western Pasque Flower, is a flowering plant species native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever reduction, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Western Pasque Flower include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Papaver nudicaule subsp. corydalifolium include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
